description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks hit their upper or lower circuit on a day, or how often a stock has.

Returns NSE's record of securities that hit their upper or lower price band. With `date` (default the latest day held): the hits on that day. With `symbol`: that security's hits over `days` (default 90, at most 1825), newest first. Pass one or the other, not both. `direction` is "upper", "lower" or "all" (default). `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 200), and `truncated` says when there are more. This is the exchange's own list: a stock can touch its band during the day and close inside it, so closing prices do not reproduce it. NSE publishes records from 2010; stored depth depends on seeding.
name: get_price_band_hits
title: Price band hits
